ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERTELEPHONENUMBER_CCD] AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber AS 
(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,TelephoneNumberTypeId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Landline Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA,BCD.CUST_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber 
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Mobile Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
FROM  BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1
) MONTHLY

UNION 

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Landline Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA,BCD.CUST_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION 

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Mobile Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1
) DAILY
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumberTypeId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumber)
,convert(varchar,AreaCode)
,convert(varchar,CountryCode)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber 
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumberTypeId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumber)
,convert(varchar,AreaCode)
,convert(varchar,CountryCode)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD'	 AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)


,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId,TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId) AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TelephoneNumber,TGT.TelephoneNumber) AS TelephoneNumber
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'    
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31';


------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
(
    CustomerId
    ,TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,TelephoneNumber
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,PreferenceId
    ,TelephoneNumberNote
    ,LocationId
    ,TextCapableIndicator
    ,ExtensionNumber
    ,DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,DateOfRequest
    ,AreaCode
    ,CountryCode
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,SRC.TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
    ,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId
    ,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
    ,NULL AS LocationId
    ,NULL AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
    ,SRC.AreaCode AS AreaCode
    ,SRC.CountryCode AS CountryCode
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.TelephoneNumberTypeId = SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERTELEPHONENUMBER_CRM] AS
BEGIN

---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
AS(
    SELECT
     BCP.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCP.PHONEEMAILTYPE AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BCP.PHONENO AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCP.LAST_UPDATED_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCP.END_DATE AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BCP.PREFERREDFLAG AS PreferenceId
    ,BCP.WORKEXTENSION AS ExtensionNumber
    ,BCP.DONOTDISTURB AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,BCP.DATEOFREQUEST AS DateOfRequest
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) as  INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCP.BANK_ID   AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCP.SOURCE_CODE  AS SourceCode
    FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL BCP
    WHERE BCP.isLatest = '1'  AND BCP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE'

    UNION ALL

    select DISTINCT A.orgkey AS CustomerId
    ,'SMSBANKING' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,A.SMSBANKINGMOBILENUMBER AS TelephoneNumber
    ,A.TMDATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'9999-12-31'  AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId
    ,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    ,A.BANK_ID  AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,A.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
    from busc.crm_accounts A
    WHERE A.isLatest = '1' AND A.SMSBANKINGMOBILENUMBER <> ''

)

SELECT DISTINCT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumberTypeId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumber)
,convert(varchar,PreferenceId)
,convert(varchar,ExtensionNumber)
,convert(varchar,trim(DoNotDisturbIndicator))
,convert(date,DateOfRequest)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumberTypeId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumber)
,convert(varchar,PreferenceId)
,convert(varchar,ExtensionNumber)
,convert(varchar,trim(DoNotDisturbIndicator))
,convert(date,DateOfRequest)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId,TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId) AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TelephoneNumber,TGT.TelephoneNumber) AS TelephoneNumber
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SourceCode = 'CRM' ;   


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber( 
[CustomerId]
,[TelephoneNumberTypeId]
,[TelephoneNumber]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[PreferenceId]
,[TelephoneNumberNote]
,[LocationId]
,[TextCapableIndicator]
,[ExtensionNumber]
,[DoNotDisturbIndicator]
,[DateOfRequest]
,[AreaCode]
,[CountryCode]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT DISTINCT
 trim(SRC.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,trim(SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId) AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
,trim(SRC.TelephoneNumber) AS TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,trim(PreferenceId) AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
,NULL AS LocationId
,NULL AS TextCapableIndicator
,trim(ExtensionNumber) AS ExtensionNumber
,trim(DoNotDisturbIndicator) AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest AS DateOfRequest
,NULL AS AreaCode
,NULL AS CountryCode
,trim(SRC.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
,trim(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.TelephoneNumberTypeId = SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode  
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;


END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERTELEPHONENUMBER_SEC] AS
BEGIN


WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
,
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Cellphone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.CELLPHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'Y' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.CELLPHONE IS NOT NULL
AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 
AND BSC.CELLPHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 

UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Cellphone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.CELLPHONE2 AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'Y' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
FROM  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.CELLPHONE IS NOT NULL
AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.CELLPHONE2 NOT IN ('',' ') 

UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Home Phone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.HOME_PHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'N' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
FROM  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.HOME_PHONE IS NOT NULL
AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.HOME_PHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 


UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Office Phone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.OFC_PHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'N' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
FROM  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.OFC_PHONE IS NOT NULL
AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.OFC_PHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 


UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Permanent Address Phone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.PERM_PHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'N' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
FROM  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.PERM_PHONE IS NOT NULL
AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.PERM_PHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 

)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumberTypeId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumber)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumberTypeId)
,convert(varchar,TelephoneNumber)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, TelephoneNumberTypeId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' AND SourceCode = 'SEC'	
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId,TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId) AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TelephoneNumber,TGT.TelephoneNumber) AS TelephoneNumber
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
          WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'  
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

-------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId = TGT.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	;

---------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[TelephoneNumberTypeId]
,[TelephoneNumber]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[PreferenceId]
,[TelephoneNumberNote]
,[LocationId]
,[TextCapableIndicator]
,[ExtensionNumber]
,[DoNotDisturbIndicator]
,[DateOfRequest]
,[AreaCode]
,[CountryCode]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT DISTINCT
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
,SRC.TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
,NULL AS LocationId
,SRC.TextCapableIndicator AS TextCapableIndicator
,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
,NULL AS DateOfRequest
,NULL AS AreaCode
,NULL AS CountryCode
,SRC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.TelephoneNumberTypeId = SRC.TelephoneNumberTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode  
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;


END
